questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you to follow a different route because the normal road is blocked by construction work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from the right lane is merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires a complete stop. You must let all vehicles and pedestrians pass before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a detour is 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Vertical traffic signals have red on top and green on the bottom. Horizontal traffic signals have red on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the shared center lane is for left turns only. Drivers from both directions can use it to turn left, but not as a regular driving lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a side road is coming up ahead. Be alert for traffic that may enter from the side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to road and traffic conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is not allowed. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you should be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign warns of either a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder drops lower than the road ahead. If your wheel drifts onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at the intersection ahead and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you a yield sign is ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.
